style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. Real 3D render output, editable Blender sources. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks. Follow-on design exploration: improve the modeling itself, including forms, proportions, structure, crafted details and decorations. Original part counts and awkward geometry are not constraints. The editor may rebuild native geometry to achieve the better design; the judge should reward useful improvements. Preserve the locked registration, gameplay contact/clearance, animation and modular continuity contract. See modeling-policy.json version2.

qualityCriteria.definitionOfGood: A crafted blue/cyan wreck frame with substantial soft edge volumes, purposeful wear/slate hardware/pale accents and seamless native repeated connections in every facing.

priorityOutcomes.outcome: Hull rails/planks, ribs and fastening hardware read as substantial worn constructed pieces with rounded or faceted soft edge volume. Improve weak proportions and construction where useful; counts and original boxes are not locked.

Keep observed blue/cyan hull, dark slate structure and pale metal accents. Warm cream wear highlights are restrained. Avoid shifting the whole family to yellow rock or creating deep featureless black regions.

Broad soft value changes describe native volume in every facing with no preferred horizontal illumination. Highlights follow material and form without white glare, glowing fringe or directional ground shadow.

Purposeful shallow grain, chips, dents or bevel wear communicate wreck age and distinguish hull from hardware. Detail supports the large form and remains coherent at phone32; do not require literal ImageGen cracks.

At logical128 the continuous hull construction and hardware hierarchy are immediately legible, and at phone32 the asset still reads as a wreck section rather than blue stripes with black holes. Four views form one native object.

All4 independent repeated sprites and actual consumer joins are clean on light/gray/dark. Reject narrow local cut lines, alpha punctures, doubled rims/endcaps, abrupt normals/material fields, clipping and unrelated repeat decoration. A small numerical residual does not waive a visible seam.

hardConstraints: True W/E planes X±.5, source ordered asymmetric three disconnected rectangular YZ sections: lower Y±.18/Z.04...20; upper Y±.09/Z.60...74; rear lip Y.20...26/Z.16...35. Preserve exact measured float geometry/winding/handedness and proper all4 root rotations; no mirrored rear lip, port growth or rounded join cuts.

Keep root(0,0,0), pitch1, occupied cell[[0,0]], sockets{}, static frame1/one unique frame/12fps/nonloop/all4. Finite lowest lower-rail support X±.5/Y±.18 at Z.04/area.36; empty geometric Z0 and .04 ground clearance. Do not invent a fullfloor ground patch.

Measured hardware-dependent source3D convex hull/per-part boxes/old counts/blank bays are observations, not extra hard locks. Native forms/structure/decoration may change inside this budget; no AABB-only certification.

samplingProposal.rationale: Own unedited-source diagnostic: historical 1.5+LANCZOS repeats have interior alpha loss; direct narrow native2 removes those S samples and avoids separately averaging depth-facing cutface occlusion before composition.
samplingProposal.limits: Connected-native and actual consumer evidence are still pending for a redesigned candidate. Three partial-alpha outer rivet pixels per E/W are retained, not repaired or counted as interior holes.

nativeEvidence.singleCaptures: One registered static capture in each facing, actual root/camera matrices and shader/native geometry fields measured while capturing.
nativeEvidence.independentRepeated: Three independently captured modules, 1-world-cell spacing, per facing. S/N chain along projected X; E/W chain along projected depth. Use true handed W/E ports and correct painter order. No image overlap or registration offsets.
nativeEvidence.nativeReference: One native 3-module assembly reference per facing at the same projected scale and light recipe; retain exact geometry, no subject fitting. Derive canvas extension/root from world spacing, with no per-view scale adjustment.
nativeEvidence.comparisons: Save full raw finite-light RGB/alpha comparison separately from projected finite-port collar masks, local seam contrast and interior alpha defect masks. Show light/gray/dark at logical128 and phone32; enlarged sheets support but do not replace use-size inspection.
nativeEvidence.finiteValidation: Compare evaluated mesh-plane ordered profiles, native winding/handedness and finite lowest support patch. Check candidate against the explicitly root-frozen measured finite envelope in authored coordinates for every facing. Verify actual active endpoint shader/normal fields across a finite collar.

consumer.fixture: Use actual candidate atlas, spriteFrame/groundRoot/orderPlacements, worldRasterPlan/paintWorldRaster through the unchanged modules. Save one independent native canvas and the displayed CSS screenshot for each case/mode. Include all4 facings plus light #eeeeee, gray #808080 and dark #151923. Retain fixture input hashes and actual browser version/options.
consumer.boundedCount: 8 browser case/mode captures total, each covering all declared facings/backgrounds; expand only for a concrete failure.

judgment.coverage: Fresh judge must inspect every exact packet candidateRenders/previews path; explicit hash-identical aliases may share a verified inspection. Missing native or consumer evidence is needs_evidence, never approval.
judgment.visibleBar: No narrow local seam, exposed end, doubled rim, alpha puncture or material/normal discontinuity at logical128/phone32 in any facing or background. Retain broad finite-light/outer-precision residuals honestly; no numerical-only waiver.
judgment.futureGate: Before future approval, run unchanged tools/acceptance_contract.py and audit_directions.py on the actual sealed candidate packet. This preparation is not a candidate packet and does not run an approval gate.
